title: Instrument prospective T6 rotation survival and delay-cost rows
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic prospective T6 ROTATION_SURVIVAL_FORWARD row producer and validator that freezes first-cross baseline, sequence start and available ETHBTC/breadth/BTC.D/deployment/flow states before outcomes, then measures survival, delay cost, failure outcome and exit-side outcome as evidence matures. Preserve missingness and right censoring. Do not invent missing axes, thresholds or portfolio actions.
allowed_change_scope: scripts/learning/directly related T6 rotation survival producer and validator
06_RESEARCH_LAB/forward_tests/directly related machine-readable T6 runtime artifact if an existing owner path requires it

evidence.summary: T6 is QUEUED_DATA_DEPENDENT with zero forward-confirmed rows; required fields explicitly include sequence/time-in-state, ETHBTC/breadth/BTC.D/deployment/flow survival, incremental value, delay cost, failure outcome and exit-side outcome.

Current main already produces non-binding rotation cadence observations and optional richer breadth checkpoints, providing existing operational evidence that must remain separate from market authority.
Comparable breadth history remains a prospectively collecting evidence gap; T6 instrumentation must preserve missingness rather than fabricate continuity.

reproduction: On fresh main, inspect T6 in the Active Test Registry. Verify rows_total and valid_outcome_rows remain zero and blocker is MULTI_AXIS_DATA_COMPLETENESS. Search current scripts/workflows for a producer that freezes FIRST_ETHBTC_CROSS and a sequence_id before outcomes, records right-censored survival by each available axis and later computes delay_cost/failure_outcome/exit_side_outcome. If complete instrumentation already exists, stop as clean no-op; otherwise implement only the missing prospective row lifecycle.

positive: An eligible first-cross event freezes one immutable sequence source row before outcome evidence, including sequence_id, sequence_start_utc, explicit available/missing axis states and right_censored=true.

Subsequent observations update survival through append-only observations or immutable sidecars and can later compute delay_cost versus the frozen FIRST_ETHBTC_CROSS baseline without rewriting the initial row.
A failed/reversed sequence records failure_outcome and exit_side_outcome only from source-bound post-freeze evidence.
negative: Missing breadth, BTC.D, deployment or flow remains explicit missingness and cannot be inferred or counted as confirmation.
No historical proxy percentage is promoted into a live threshold and cadence-only operational triggers cannot become market rules.
No row or outcome may be created retrospectively after observing the result, and no automatic portfolio action or phase promotion is allowed.
